ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: angry at the heavens
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has had hard words for {LABEL} since {OTHER} died, rites and all.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has turned on {PAWN_possessive} faith since {OTHER_nameDef} died.

plain.li: We gave {OTHER_nameDef} every rite {LABEL} has. It didn't bring {OTHER_objective} back, and I'm done pretending it might have.
I said the words over {OTHER_nameDef} like I was taught. Then I walked off and kicked a wall until my foot hurt more than the rest of me.
If {LABEL} was listening, it had a strange way of showing it. {OTHER_nameDef} is still dead.

warm.li: I prayed for {OTHER_nameDef} every night. I don't know who I was talking to. I'm angry, and I don't know who at.

blunt.li: Did the rites for {OTHER_nameDef}. Waste of breath. Said so.

cheerful.li: I can usually laugh at anything. Not this. {OTHER_nameDef} deserved better than a few words and a hole.

gloomy.li: So that's what {LABEL} is worth when it counts. Nothing. I should have known.

cold.li: The rites of {LABEL} were observed for {OTHER_nameDef}. They changed nothing. I note that, and I resent it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: rites that didn't comfort
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has prayed less since {OTHER} died, for all that {LABEL} had to offer.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef}'s faith has been shaken since {OTHER_nameDef} died.

plain.li: Everyone says {LABEL} will carry me through losing {OTHER_nameDef}. I knelt for an hour tonight and felt nothing come.
The funeral was done properly. I keep waiting for it to help. It hasn't, and I don't know what that says about me, or about the faith.
I used to know what happens to us after. Since {OTHER_nameDef}, I find I'm only hoping.

warm.li: I want to believe {OTHER_nameDef} is somewhere kind now. Wanting it and believing it used to be the same thing.

blunt.li: The rites didn't help. Missing {OTHER_nameDef} is all I've got. Faith can wait.

cheerful.li: I tried to say a prayer for {OTHER_nameDef} and couldn't remember how it went. That's never happened before. It frightened me.

gloomy.li: {LABEL} promised comfort. I've had none. Perhaps there was never any to have.

cold.li: I have examined my faith since {OTHER_nameDef}'s death. It holds up less well than I had assumed.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: saved by a believer of another ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has looked at {LABEL} with new eyes since {OTHER}, who keeps it, saved {PAWN_objective}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has been asking {OTHER_nameDef} about {LABEL} since {OTHER_pronoun} saved {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't pray the way I do, and {OTHER_pronoun} saved my life anyway. I keep turning that over.
I was raised to think little of {LABEL}. It was one of its own who got me through. I owe it a fairer hearing.
Asked {OTHER_nameDef} what {OTHER_pronoun} says before sleeping. I'd never thought to ask before.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} looked after me like I was {OTHER_possessive} own. Whatever {LABEL} teaches, it taught {OTHER_objective} that.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} saved my neck. Keeps {LABEL}. Can't be all wrong, then.

cheerful.li: I'm alive, thanks to {OTHER_nameDef}, who's been trying to tell me about {LABEL} for weeks. I suppose I'll have to listen now.

gloomy.li: My own faith didn't send anyone. {OTHER_nameDef}'s did. I don't like what that might mean.

cold.li: I was saved by a believer in {LABEL}. I am revising some opinions I held about it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: worn down by their ideoligion's demands
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has asked whether {LABEL} asks too much of {PAWN_objective}, after days of carrying it.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has begun to wonder whether {PAWN_possessive} faith asks too much.

plain.li: Day after day of doing without what {LABEL} says I must have. I'm starting to ask who it's for.
I keep the ways of {LABEL}, and I'm miserable keeping them while the others seem glad to.
Something {LABEL} asks has been eating at me all week. Tonight I wondered whether it has to.

warm.li: I don't want to let the others of {LABEL} down. But I'm tired, and the faith never seems to notice.

blunt.li: {LABEL} wants things this colony can't give. I'm sick of paying for it.

cheerful.li: I've been a good believer all week and all I've got for it is a sour face. I'm starting to think the rules were written by someone with a bigger house.

gloomy.li: Every day {LABEL} finds a new way I'm falling short. Maybe I'm not the one at fault.

cold.li: The demands of {LABEL} cost me more than they return. I am reconsidering the arrangement.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: came close to death
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has held {LABEL} more loosely since coming so close to death.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} came close to dying, and {PAWN_possessive} faith hasn't been the same since.

plain.li: I nearly died. I always thought I'd see something, at the end. There was only the cold and the ceiling.
They tell me I was nearly gone. I don't remember {LABEL} being anywhere near me.
Up and walking again. The faith I had before feels like a coat that doesn't fit any more.

warm.li: I thought of everyone here when I was going. Not of {LABEL}. I'm not sure what to make of that.

blunt.li: Nearly died. Nobody came for me but the doctor. Noted.

cheerful.li: The other side is very quiet and smells of the infirmary. I expected more from {LABEL}.

gloomy.li: I was nearly dead, and there was nothing waiting. I can't stop thinking about the nothing.

cold.li: At the edge of death I observed no evidence for the teachings of {LABEL}. I find the absence significant.
